name.description:
Name of the resource, unique per kind within its namespace. Lowercase
letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

namespace.description: Namespace the resource belongs to, usually one per customer.

labels.description: Labels are free-form key/value pairs for selecting and grouping.

metadata.description: Metadata names the subject kind, e.g. paciente.

spec.description: Spec says how a subject is identified and described.

type.description: Type is string, int or bool.

enum.description:
Enum lists the allowed values of a string attribute; required for
strings, so no free text is stored.

description.description: Description says who the subjects are.

id.description:
ID is a string expression that identifies the subject where a
milestone is recorded, e.g. caller.patientId. Use a pseudonymous ID,
never a phone or an e-mail.

attributes.description:
Attributes are the dimensions numbers can be cut by. They are typed
and closed: free text could carry personal data.
